title: crypto2dev: TLS integration
description: Wire the crypto2dev CryptoCb shim into wolfSSL's TLS layer so that a TLS server or client can transparently use /dev/crypto2dev for its cryptographic operations. Covers: helper APIs to assign devId to SSL_CTX objects, analysis of which TLS handshake operations will hit hardware vs. fall back to software, transcript hash policy, and integration tests verifying a TLS 1.3 and TLS 1.2 handshake end-to-end with crypto2dev active.
notes: Depends on wolfssl-0h3 (all CryptoCb callbacks implemented). Key constraint: transcript hashes (wc_Sha256/wc_Sha384 objects used for the Transcript-Hash during key derivation) must NOT have devId set because wolfSSL calls wc_Sha256Copy() on them and hardware cannot snapshot mid-stream state. The helper API must handle this distinction.
